xBRIEFInfo.author: overdeck/0.0.0
xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-4752: Flywheel board shows strike workspaces as bogus PAN-<n>-STRIKE issues with 'tracker unknown'

plan.title: Flywheel board shows strike workspaces as bogus PAN-<n>-STRIKE issues with 'tracker unknown'
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: listFeatureWorkspaces derives PAN-4669-STRIKE from workspaces/feature-pan-4669-strike, and deriveFlywheelStatus puts that id on the Flywheel board unchanged. The tracker has no such issue, so five live rows show 'tracker unknown', backlog, and no PR, while their strike agents count toward no row.
narratives.Proposal: Fold strike census entries and strike tick ids onto their base issue id inside deriveFlywheelStatus (deacon census untouched), mark the row with a new optional contract field strike: true, overlay the open strike/<id> PR from the cached forge listing when the issue has no feature PR (in-review/changes-requested; merged or closed strike PRs ignored because the branch is reused), and render a neutral strike badge on the page and a ' · strike' suffix in the CLI. Document it in docs/FLYWHEEL.md.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Changing src/lib/cloister/deacon-workspaces.ts or any deacon consumer
- Showing strike folding on Command Deck, the Pipeline page, or God View
- Teaching loadIssueStatesForProject or issueIdFromBranch about strike/ heads
- Deriving 'ready' for strike PRs or routing strikes through the merge gate
- Showing a separate row for a strike when the base workspace also exists
- Raising the file-size allowlist for derived-issue-state.ts
- Rewriting lastTick.pick or other tick-marker text (the no -STRIKE guarantee covers in-flight row ids only)
- Treating a merged strike/<id> PR as completing the current strike

autoDecisions.summary: Fold happens in deriveFlywheelStatus after listWorkspaces returns, not in defaultListWorkspaces or the deacon census
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue forbids changing deacon-workspaces.ts, and injected listWorkspaces (tests, future server deps) must get the same fold.

autoDecisions.summary: One row per base id when both base and strike workspaces exist; base workspace journal wins; strike: true
autoDecisions.rationale: The page keys rows by issueId, so two rows would collide; the base workspace holds the pipeline journal.

autoDecisions.summary: Feature-branch PR wins over the strike PR; strike PR used only when derived.pr is absent
autoDecisions.rationale: The base pipeline is the authority when it has a PR; the strike PR fills the gap the issue describes.

autoDecisions.summary: Only an open strike PR is used: it derives in-review (changes-requested when requested); merged/closed strike PRs are ignored; tracker closed always wins; never ready from a strike PR
autoDecisions.rationale: pan strike reuses strike/<id> across runs, so a merged PR on that head may belong to an earlier strike (plan critique); open-only is safe and matches the issue's 'open strike/<id> PR'.

autoDecisions.summary: Strike PR read via the cached forge listings (listRepoPullRequests/prFromGhRow, listRepoMergeRequests/mrFromGlabRow) and a pure selectOpenStrikePr, injected as readStrikePr
autoDecisions.rationale: Reuses cached listings (no extra forge calls), covers GitHub and GitLab, and adds zero lines to derived-issue-state.ts (981/1000) — only two export keywords.

autoDecisions.summary: Neutral 'strike' StatusBadge on the page and ' · strike' suffix in the CLI
autoDecisions.rationale: Identity marker, not a status signal; follows the existing trackerUnknown marker pattern and pan-style-guide color restraint.

autoDecisions.summary: Tick-marker ids ending in -STRIKE are folded too
autoDecisions.rationale: The acceptance criterion says no -STRIKE id may appear on the board from any source; the cost is one regex.

autoDecisions.summary: When the strike PR overlay applies, drop 'work-not-started' attention and keep other attention values
autoDecisions.rationale: work-not-started means no PR and no live pane; an open strike PR contradicts it.

metadata.sizeJustification: One optional contract field threaded through its single deriver, its two renderers (page and CLI), and one doc; 11 files, each change a few lines.

narrative.Action: PRD W3 (decisions D5-D7, D9; Critique response). In src/lib/overdeck/derived-issue-state.ts add only the `export` keyword to `interface GlabMrRow` and `async function listRepoMergeRequests` (zero added lines; never raise the allowlist). In derive-status.ts: add dep `readStrikePr?: (projectPath, issueId) => DerivedPrState | null | Promise<…>`; add pure exported `selectOpenStrikePr(prs: readonly (LoadedPr | null)[])` that ignores null and merged PRs and returns the highest-numbered open PR as DerivedPrState (no merged key); add lazy default `defaultReadStrikePr` that reads the cached listing by forge (gitlab: listRepoMergeRequests + mrFromGlabRow filtered by source_branch; else listRepoPullRequests + prFromGhRow filtered by headRefName) for branch `strike/<lower-case id>` and passes the mapped rows to selectOpenStrikePr. Merged/closed strike PRs never count because pan strike reuses the branch across runs. In the row map call readStrikePr only when candidate.strike && !derived?.pr. State: derived 'closed' stays closed; else open strike PR with reviewState 'changes-requested' -> 'changes-requested', otherwise 'in-review'; never 'ready' from a strike PR. Row pr = derived.pr if present else the strike PR. When the overlay applies drop attention 'work-not-started', keep other attention values. Add forgeForProject, listRepoPullRequests, listRepoMergeRequests, prFromGhRow, mrFromGlabRow vi.fn stubs to the vi.mock factory of derived-issue-state.js at the top of tests/unit/lib/flywheel/derive-status.test.ts (it currently exports exactly three names). Add PRD tests 6-11.
